FN-9T98PBM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 73
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/16/2024
Senate Bill 73 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
annually by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of gross receipts derived from
the sale of certain fencing materials used for the purpose of fencing in agriculture livestock
applications.

FN-9T98PBM-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 73
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/12/2024
Senate Bill 73 as passed the Senate would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 through Fiscal Year 2029, by an undetermined amount
annually dependent on the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of certain fence
material, up to $25,000, used for the purpose of fencing in agriculture livestock applications.
In addition, this bill could also decrease sales tax receipts to counties and municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent on if the local government adopts the exemption provided by
this bill.
